promptLatex: How many positive integers less than or equal to 100 are divisible by 2 or 3?
hintLatex: Use inclusion-exclusion: count multiples of 2, count multiples of 3, then subtract multiples of 6 (which are counted twice).
There are 50 multiples of 2, 33 multiples of 3, and 16 multiples of 6.
solutionLatex:
Use the inclusion-exclusion principle.

Number of multiples of 2 up to 100: \lfloor 100/2 \rfloor = 50.
Number of multiples of 3 up to 100: \lfloor 100/3 \rfloor = 33.
Number of multiples of both 2 and 3 (i.e., multiples of 6) up to 100: \lfloor 100/6 \rfloor = 16.

By inclusion-exclusion: 50 + 33 - 16 = 67.
